:::{#exr-review-exp-dist}
Recall the key characteristics of the [exponential distribution](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-exponential):

- [density function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-pdf) $\pdf(t)$
- [survival function](intro-to-survival-analysis.qmd#def-surv-fn) $\surv(t)$
- [hazard function](intro-to-survival-analysis.qmd#def-hazard) $\haz(t)$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-review-exp-dist}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\dens(t) &= \lambda e^{-\lambda t}\\
\surv(t) &= e^{-\lambda t}\\
\haz(t) &= \lambda
\end{aligned}
$$

::: notes
Note that the exponential distribution has **constant hazard**.
:::

:::
